categories.main_business_segments: China Post Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of intelligent logistics systems and intelligent special vehicles. Its main products include intelligent sorting systems, intelligent transportation systems, and intelligent special vehicles, serving various application scenarios with customized, professional, and intelligent logistics solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine vision, embedded systems, and automation in its products. Key proprietary technologies include AI-based high-precision mixed parcel automatic separation, dynamic algorithm-based high-speed control, modular sorting machines for irregular items, servo-driven high-speed wheel control, and green carbon-neutral logistics equipment. Manufacturing is centralized in a smart manufacturing base in Guangzhou Nansha, featuring automated production lines and self-developed core components like electric rollers and controllers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading customers in the express delivery, e-commerce, tobacco, automotive, airport, and warehousing sectors. Major clients include China Post Group, SF Express, JD.com, Deppon Logistics, Yunda Express, Huawei, 3M China, Haier, China Tobacco, and Southern Power Grid. The company also targets emerging markets such as airports, tobacco, manufacturing, and overseas markets, expanding its business from project and product sales to after-sales maintenance services.
categories.geographic_coverage: China Post Technology operates primarily within China, covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities except Macau and Taiwan. It has also expanded into Southeast Asia, Europe, Oceania, the Americas, and Africa. The majority of revenue is generated domestically, with international sales accounting for a small but growing portion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the intelligent logistics equipment supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of intelligent logistics systems and components, as well as system integration and on-site installation. It also provides downstream services such as after-sales maintenance and technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company aims to be a leader in intelligent logistics technology R&D, system integration, and solution services. It emphasizes innovation in AI, machine vision, and automation, with significant R&D investments focused on intelligent sorting, transportation, and core control technologies. The company pursues product upgrades, domestic component localization, and expansion into new application scenarios like airports, tobacco, and cold chain logistics, while also accelerating international market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of intelligent logistics systems, intelligent special vehicles, spare parts, and technical services. The company uses a direct sales model domestically and contracts directly or through authorized agents internationally. It also derives income from after-sales maintenance and technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Post Technology is a leading domestic provider in the intelligent logistics equipment industry with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong system integration capabilities. It holds a competitive edge through its long-term project experience, advanced proprietary technologies, and stable relationships with major industry players. The company faces increasing competition as new entrants and existing competitors enhance their capital and R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.95 billion, a 12.05% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 71.6 million, down 9.5%. The company completed its IPO in November 2023, issuing 34 million new shares, increasing total shares to 136 million. Despite revenue decline due to market adjustments, the company’s net assets grew by 41.66% to RMB 1.73 billion, supported by IPO proceeds. R&D investment increased by 16.13% to RMB 101.5 million, representing 5.2% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its advanced AI-driven intelligent sorting and transportation technologies, high customization capability, and comprehensive system integration services. It offers high-speed, high-precision sorting solutions capable of handling diverse parcel types including irregular and oversized items. Its smart manufacturing base enhances production efficiency and product quality. The company’s strong R&D foundation, stable quality management, and extensive customer base in key industries underpin its competitive advantage.
